atc_analysis.raw_markdown:
### 1. Standard Documents Required
* None specified in the provided text.

### 2. Clarified ATC Documents & Mandatory Uploads
* **Certificate**: Copy of valid **GST Registration Certificate** (mentioning new GSTIN with SAC/HSN codes), **Valid RSP Vendor Registration Certificate** (if available)
* **Additional Doc 1**: Documents in support of **Technical Requirements** (as per eligibility criteria), Documents in support of **Ownership Details** (Proprietary/Partnership/Pvt. Ltd/Public Ltd), **Undertaking as per Annexure-A** (on company letterhead), **Acceptance of all Terms & Conditions** (Annexure-1), **Details as per Annexure-S** (mandatory for case value ≥ 1 Crore), **Local Content Certificate** (as per Annexure-2A/2B), **Integrity Pact** (signed by bidder), **EMD/EMD Exemption documents**
* **Other Upload Required in ATC**: **List of supporting documents** on company letterhead (as per Annexure-S) including contact details (postal address, email, phone) of the issuing authority for verification.

### 3. Exemption Documents Required
* **Proof for Exemption (MSEs)**: **Udyam Registration Certificate (URC)** (Explicit)
* **Proof for Exemption (Start-ups)**: **DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate** (Inferred)

### 4. Physical Submissions (Offline)
* **Shortfall/Confirmatory Documents**: If requested by SAIL-RSP, documents may be submitted via courier/registered post/speed post.
  * Deadline: As specified in the written communication from SAIL-RSP.
  * In Favor Of: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)
  * Payable At: As specified in the tender/communication.
  * Delivery Address: As specified in the written communication from SAIL-RSP.

### 5. Key Commercial Terms & Conditions to Follow
* **Eligibility**: Only **RSP-SAIL registered vendors** specifically invited against this Limited Tender Enquiry (LTE) are eligible.
* **Pricing**: Bidders must quote the **overall lot value**. Item-wise rates will be derived based on the specified weightage percentages.
* **Abnormally Low Bids**: Bids quoting below 25% of the estimated value may be required to submit a **Performance Guarantee (PGB)**.
* **GST Compliance**: Bidders must ensure their accounting/IT systems are GST compliant to ensure timely availability of **Input Tax Credit (ITC)** to SAIL.
* **Safety Compliance**: Contractor must obtain **written safety clearance** from the Safety Engineering Department before starting work.
* **Penalty**: Penalty for safety violations will be assessed by the Head of Safety Engineering and the Head of the executing department; amounts are recoverable from bills or Security Deposit.
* **Statutory Compliance**: Contractor must obtain a **Labour License** within 15 days of contract award.
* **Verification**: SAIL reserves the right to verify any submitted document from the issuing authority; submission of fake/forged documents leads to punitive action and contract termination.
